mapper.select: select count(*) from user u left join user_penalty p on p.user_id = u.user_id and p.penalty_id = ( select max(p2.penalty_id) from user_penalty p2 where p2.user_id = u.user_id ) where u.grade = 'User' and ( #{status} = 'ALL' or (#{status} = 'NORMAL' and (u.suspended = 0 or u.suspended is null)) or (#{status} = 'SUSPENDED' and u.suspended = 1) or (#{status} = 'PENALTY' and p.score != 0) ) and ( #{keyword} = '' or u.login_id like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.nickname like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

select u.user_id, u.name, u.login_id, u.nickname, u.suspended, p.score from user u left join user_penalty p on p.user_id = u.user_id and p.penalty_id = ( select max(p2.penalty_id) from user_penalty p2 where p2.user_id = u.user_id ) where u.grade = 'User' and ( #{status} = 'ALL' or (#{status} = 'NORMAL' and (u.suspended = 0 or u.suspended is null)) or (#{status} = 'SUSPENDED' and u.suspended = 1) or (#{status} = 'PENALTY' and p.score != 0) ) and ( #{keyword} = '' or u.login_id like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.nickname like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) order by u.user_id desc limit #{row}, 10

select u.user_id, u.login_id, u.name, u.nickname, u.suspended, u.withdrawal_at, u.email, u.profile_image, p.score, p.permanent_suspension, p.received_at, p.suspension_start_at, p.suspension_end_at, p.reason, p.penalty_id from user u left join user_penalty p on u.user_id = p.user_id where u.user_id = #{userId} order by p.penalty_id desc
select score from user_penalty where user_id = #{userId} order by penalty_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into user_penalty (user_id, received_at, score, reason, suspension_start_at, suspension_end_at, permanent_suspension) values (#{userId}, now(), #{score}, #{reason}, now(), date_add(now(), interval #{days} day), 0)
insert into user_penalty (user_id, received_at, score, reason, suspension_start_at, suspension_end_at, permanent_suspension) values (#{userId}, now(), #{score}, #{reason}, now(), null, 1)
insert into user_penalty (user_id, received_at, score, reason, permanent_suspension) values (#{userId}, now(), #{score}, #{reason}, 0)
mapper.select: select u.user_id, p.score from user u join user_penalty p on p.user_id = u.user_id and p.penalty_id = ( select max(p2.penalty_id) from user_penalty p2 where p2.user_id = u.user_id ) where u.grade = 'User' and p.score >= 30 and p.score < 100 and not exists ( select 1 from user_penalty s where s.user_id = u.user_id and s.suspension_start_at is not null and s.score >= (case when p.score >= 60 then 60 else 30 end) )

select u.user_id, u.nickname, p.score from user u join user_penalty p on p.user_id = u.user_id and p.penalty_id = ( select max(p2.penalty_id) from user_penalty p2 where p2.user_id = u.user_id ) where u.grade = 'User' and p.score >= 100 and not exists ( select 1 from user_penalty s where s.user_id = u.user_id and s.permanent_suspension = 1 ) and not exists ( select 1 from notification n where n.title = '영구정지 검토 필요' and n.link = concat('/admin/member/detail?userId=', u.user_id) )
select user_id from user where grade = 'Admin'
